title: Permutation Importance with sklearn.inspection
learning_objectives: Measure feature importance with permutation_importance on held-out data
Apply it to a whole pipeline so importances refer to the original columns
Report the mean and spread over repeats
entry_point: importance_table(model, X, y, n_repeats=10, seed=0, scoring=None)
hints: Check `isinstance(X, pd.DataFrame)` and the repeat count.
`result = permutation_importance(model, X, y, n_repeats=n_repeats, random_state=seed, scoring=scoring)`.
Zip `X.columns`, `result.importances_mean` and `result.importances_std`, then sort by `(-mean, column)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Sort rows by mean importance, largest first.
Pass the whole pipeline and the DataFrame so rows are original columns.
Use permutation_importance with random_state=seed and the given scoring.
